connector.name: text2sql
connector.registryDescription: Ask any SQL database in natural language. Agent explores schema, writes SQL, self-corrects.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package text2sql-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the cpenniman12 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: TEXT2SQL_DATABASE_URL
env.description: SQLAlchemy connection URL, e.g. sqlite:///mydb.db or postgresql://user:pass@host/db

env.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
env.description: Anthropic API key (required if using the default Anthropic model)

env.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
env.description: OpenAI API key (required when TEXT2SQL_MODEL is set to an openai:* model)
